blurb: One of the largest museums in Asia, with 5,000 years of Korean history.

facts.t: Two gilt-bronze Pensive Bodhisattvas from the 6th and 7th centuries, both National Treasures, share a dark room of their own, with nothing else to look at.
The museum moved to Yongsan in 2005, into a building 400 metres long, so big that a ten-storey stone pagoda from the Goryeo period stands inside it.
